behavior: Launch against displays 1280×800 and 1920×1080 and a no-display-metadata fixture; inspect initial window options, then unmaximize.

Initially maximized and focused, minimum960×640. Restore bounds are min(displayWidth×0.85,1440) by min(displayHeight×0.9,920), centered; no-display fallback1240×840. Composer is focused and app id is dev.orbit.pi.
error: Inject failure from the native open_window adapter, then retry opening without creating another app controller.
The source logs 'Orbit: could not open the main window' and returns; no success window handle, duplicate OrbitApp or duplicate heartbeat is created.
loading: Start a fixture streaming Pi session, close all windows, advance the heartbeat, finish the session and reopen.
The app-owned heartbeat still drains while windowless:90ms idle and16ms active after each observed tick; repaint is unnecessary without a window. This is not a window-loading spinner.
persistence: Record OrbitApp identity and child PID; close the macOS window without quitting; reopen from Dock and compare.
The same global shell entity and existing Pi child are reused. This gate concerns in-process retention, not disk session restoration after full app exit.
keyboard: Use native window close and the macOS application reopen event; inspect app command bindings for a dedicated resize/reopen action.
No app-specific resize or reopen keyboard chord is invented. Composer focus is restored by open(); normal OS window controls retain their native behavior.
repeat: Close and reopen the main window three times while a controlled Pi child emits numbered events.
One retained controller and child, one heartbeat; every event is reduced once and returning window shows the current session. Actual macOS Dock behavior remains a native-OS gate.

behavior: Drag Sidebar, Review, Explorer and Terminal below minimum, to a normal size and above maximum; toggle full-width Review independently.

Sidebar default248/min200; Review default460/min300/drag max900; Explorer default248/min172/max460; Terminal default260/min96. Main content retains480px reserve where the source resize handler applies it. Full-width Review preserves its separate restore width.
error: Make the fixture ~/.orbit-pi/layout.json parent unwritable; drag and allow the settle flush. Restore permission, change a size again and flush.

Pinned Layout.persist ignores write errors: current live size remains, old disk state is not falsely claimed updated, and a later changed size can persist. This action has no session-scan or Pi dependency.
loading: Record a size change at t=0; flush at499ms and500ms. Record an identical value at400ms and repeat.
No disk write before500ms; one flush when changed value has settled. Recording the same value does not rearm the timer. Resizing is immediate and has no loading spinner.
persistence: Persist sidebar_width248, sidepane_width460, explorer_width300, terminal_height260 in ~/.orbit-pi/layout.json; relaunch. Repeat with missing, text,10,99999 and nonfinite parsed fields.

Only those four sizes belong to this store. Numeric finite values in inclusive80…4000 survive parsing before panel-specific clamps; invalid fields become absent/default independently. Malformed file defaults all fields. Open panels, fonts and theme are not restored by this file.
keyboard: After resizing use Cmd+B/Ctrl+B, Cmd+Shift+E/Ctrl+Shift+E and Cmd+J/Ctrl+J to toggle Sidebar, Explorer and Terminal; reopen each.

The registered source panel actions toggle visibility without treating those keys as resize commands; remembered size is retained. Review ToggleSidePanel has no chord in this command entry, so no invented key is required.
repeat: Perform100 pointer size updates, stop, then leave the splitter stationary and reopen the panel three times.
Live geometry updates without writing per pixel; one settled write per changed burst. Stationary input does not repeatedly rewrite layout.json; visibility toggles retain size.

behavior: Open a Review source without cached data; manually refresh a loaded source; then change to another source while the first load is delayed.
Loading begins immediately; a source change resets unrelated snapshot. Completion for the obsolete generation cannot replace the selected source.
error: Fail first Review collection; then load successfully and fail refreshing that same source.
First load shows unavailable/error rather than an empty-success diff. Same-source refresh preserves the previous snapshot with a visible error; failure is not cleared merely by navigating back.
loading: Complete a manually requested refresh in less than50ms using a controlled collector and clock; inspect refresh feedback at100ms,649ms and650ms.

Source refresh_from_button feedback remains active for at least650ms even when Git finishes immediately. A slow request stays loading until its actual completion; the time floor is not a fake completion delay for content.
keyboard: Focus Review and press Escape during load, then reopen and invoke the registered Refresh action.
Escape follows Review cancellation/focus behavior rather than sending agent abort. Refresh reloads the current source and keeps its source/ref/path selection.
repeat: Queue sourceA, sourceB and sourceC refreshes; release callbacks in C,A,B order while also switching workspace.
Only current generation/workspace/session/source/ref/path can apply. If a pending request was deferred while loading, it runs once after stale completion rather than being lost.
